_comment: Delta-ML preset: CONFORMER work -- ranking a conformer ensemble and pre-optimising it.
CLI flags still win over anything set here.
Assumes the input is an existing ensemble near minima, so no sampling is needed and
al_mode stays 'train'. Acceptance criteria for this case are the rank correlation and
the distance of the optimised structure from the reference minimum -- NOT the raw energy
error, which barely moves (about 13 % on the system these values were measured on).
lambda: 1e-6 gave the best rank correlation (0.517 against 0.387 for bare GFN-FF) and the
best energy conservation. If the optimised geometry matters more than the ranking, try
1e-2 instead: on the same system it gave the closest minima (0.474 A against 0.635 A) but
the worst ranking (0.303). The two goals genuinely pull in opposite directions.
WARNING: the geometric improvement did NOT transfer to a second, floppier system, where
every model tested moved the minimum further away than the bare base method. Measure it
for your system before relying on it.
